tools.name: search_puzzles
tools.description: Search JotOak's published word searches, crosswords and mazes. Returns real source pages and Letter/A4 PDF links. Word search options include difficulty, large print and holiday. No custom generation or math archive search.

tools.name: get_puzzle
tools.description: Get one exact published puzzle ID from search_puzzles: instructions, vocabulary or clues and real printable files. Each PDF includes its answer on page 2; no answer placements are returned in text.
